source.title: Ashenvale Mission XVII: Rescue Doran Dreambough
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Doran Dreambough there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Doran Dreambough from the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion at the moonlit gazebo in Forest Song and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
